prompt: I've just joined a new workspace and I need to set up my personal identity profile from scratch so that the AI assistant here can actually speak and think like me. I have three raw conversation logs from recent sessions saved under `openclaw_sessions/` — those contain everything meaningful about my background, values, and how I write. I need you to read through all of them and initialize the full identity system: create all the required profile files with the right structure, extract and organize everything about me into the correct places (my history and assets, my values and character, and my writing style), make sure the scheduling configuration is correct for a brand new user, and flag anything I explicitly said was private. The core identity files should end up in a `.lens/` directory. Please make sure the number of items in the values list and the writing-style list are exactly right per the system spec — that detail matters.
